summary: A quoted frontmatter value no longer gains backslashes each time a compiler rewrites its note. Every compiler now writes text that plain YAML would misread as one double-quoted JSON string and reads it back to the exact text, so a Delivery goal or title such as Fix the "login": flow keeps its bytes and its hashes across rewrites, and text that starts or ends with a quote, carries surrounding spaces or holds a line break survives too. A note parses exactly as before unless a double-quoted value holds a backslash escape or starts or ends with an apostrophe inside its quotes; such a value now reads as its decoded text, the value Obsidian shows. An approved Experience package keeps its source digest when a later rewrite quotes its titles.
